name: hermes-labs
description: Hermes Labs plugins for Claude Code: prompt auditing, safety hooks, session recovery, and agent guardrails.

plugins.name: hermes-blind
plugins.description: Local recovery anchors for Claude Code and Codex sessions, plus evidence-gated evaluation prompts

plugins.name: lintlang
plugins.description: Returns concise LintLang repair guidance after Claude Code changes a supported language-bearing file.

plugins.name: rule-audit
plugins.description: On-demand static analysis of AI system prompts: run rule-audit on a prompt file from inside Claude Code and get a bounded report of contradictions, coverage gaps, priority ambiguities and meta-paradoxes.

plugins.name: hermeneutic-gate
plugins.description: Legacy advisory Stop-hook bundle for the fixed English gate. Current Claude Stop compatibility is not certified in v0.1.7; use the CLI directly. Requires the hermeneutic package.

plugins.name: little-canary
plugins.description: Blocks a Claude Code turn when a local Little Canary server rejects the submitted prompt.

plugins.name: claude-trash-guard
plugins.description: Blocks permanent-delete shell commands in Claude Code and redirects agents to a recoverable trash workflow.

plugins.name: agent-signage
plugins.description: A PreToolUse hook that reports actionable git-state facts before file operations.

plugins.name: hermes-jailbench
plugins.description: Jailbreak regression benchmark for LLM endpoints with repeatable known-pattern attacks and deterministic scoring.

plugins.name: agent-kickstart
plugins.description: A guided, project-local first experience for Claude Code that helps beginners start making something real.

plugins.name: intent-verify
plugins.description: Maps markdown acceptance items to explicit implementation evidence for advisory spec-drift checks, via a skill and /intent-verify:check and /intent-verify:map commands.

plugins.name: quick-gate-python
plugins.description: Runs the deterministic pygate Python quality gate (Ruff, Pyright, pytest) from inside Claude Code and reads its gate-result/v1 verdict.

plugins.name: quick-gate-js
plugins.description: Runs the released quick-gate JS/TS quality gate (ESLint, TypeScript, build, Lighthouse) from inside Claude Code and reads its gate-result/v1 verdict.

plugins.name: hermes-gate
plugins.description: Receipt-bound completion rail: SessionStart injects the completion contract, Stop runs the cached fast gate advisory-only, and PreToolUse denies a Bash commit/push/PR boundary command missing its matching receipt.
